page.notes: The first line of the page is a fragment continuing from the previous page. Some letters are blurred in the scan (e.g. "Dominis", "suum" near the foot); the word "abiit" is printed as "abiit" in the scan and may be "abiit" for "abiit"; the word "imperium" at the foot is split across the page end and continues as "rium" on the last line, which is printed at the bottom edge. Handwritten "181" at top right is not part of the print and is omitted.
